name: Crown New Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Crown New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells adhesive tape and functional film solutions in China and internationally. The company's products include industrial adhesive materials, electronic adhesive materials, and functional film materials. Its industrial adhesive materials include light industrial adhesive materials, such as double-sided tissue tape, kraft paper tape, film double-sided tape, cloth tape, and foam tape; specialty industrial adhesive materials, such as high-strength tissue tape, PET film tape, and EPT for rail transit; and automotive-grade adhesive materials including EPT for automotive, low-VOC tape, and flame retardant tape.
